company.name: BrainKey
company.shortDescription: BrainKey develops an AI‑based platform that analyzes MRI brain scans and other biomarkers to assess brain health and longevity.
company.description: BrainKey develops an AI‑based platform that analyzes MRI brain scans and other biomarkers to assess brain health and longevity. The platform offers interactive 3D visualizations of brain structures, tracks changes over time, and provides recommendations tied to nutrition, exercise, and lifestyle. It supports users in monitoring brain age and integrating imaging data with personalized insights.
